briefing.headline: xAI and DeepSeek unveil 10T-parameter joint training cluster amid escalating race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems as compute buildouts surge globally. Regulatory scrutiny intensifies around autonomous decision-making while investment flows remain robust.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 Ultra achieving new SOTA on agent benchmarks. Meta's Llama 4 family expands open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia ships Blackwell Ultra racks to xAI Memphis supercluster; Microsoft announces $50B data center expansion in Texas; TSMC begins 1.4nm AI chip production ramp.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged 100T-parameter model trigger mandatory international safety audits by Q4 2026?
